result.title: Constrained Gradient Equilibrium: Approachability under Locally Constrained Adversaries
result.summary: Gradient equilibrium (GEQ) is a recent framework in online learning that requires the time-averaged gradients along the learner's trajectory to vanish. We study GEQ when the learner is constrained and ask when such an equilibrium remains achievable in an adversarial environment. We first show that constrained GEQ (CGEQ) can be impossible even under simple and slowly varying constraints, motivating imposing local temporal structure on the adversary. We then develop an approachability framework for CGEQ under locally constrained adversaries, and obtain necessary and sufficient characterizations in the spirit of classical Blackwell approachability. Beyond these theoretical characterizations, we provide an algorithmic principle that converts window-wise no-regret learners into CGEQ algorithms under a local feasibility condition with margin. Experiments on synthetic and real data demonstrate that the resulting algorithms perform strongly in both achieving GEQ and respecting the constraints.

AI.brief_summary: 研究受限学习者的梯度均衡（CGEQ）在对抗环境中何时可实现，建立局部约束对手下的 approachability 框架与充要刻画，并给出把窗口级 no-regret 学习器转化为 CGEQ 算法的原则。
